blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The northeast monsoon, or the amihan, and the easterlies are forecast to continue to bring rains and cloudy skies over parts of the country on Friday, Nov. 13, the state weather bureau said. In its 5 a.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported that the northeast monsoon may bring cloudy skies with light rains over Cagayan, Isabela, Apayao and Kalinga. Likewise, Ilocos Region, the rest of Cordillera Administrative Region and Cagayan Valley may experience partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated light rains due to the amihan. “The amihan is weakening and […]...
